initial_requirements: The Energy Management System is intended to monitor and manage heating and cooling activity independently of the equipment it supervises. It should evaluate temperature conditions, determine when heating or cooling resources are needed, and report important operating events. Users need a reliable way to initialize the system, review its status, and understand situations such as temperature limits or unavailable equipment.
